note: What a server sends to say which champion a seat is playing, while the match is being put together.

fields.name: padding
fields.note: Unused; a client reads nothing here.

fields.name: player
fields.note: Whose champion this is. It has a player identifier's width.

fields.name: assetLength
fields.note: How many bytes the name below occupies, counting the byte that ends it.

fields.name: asset
fields.note: The champion the seat plays, as the name the client loads the champion's data under. It ends with a zero byte and is not padded.

fields.name: terminator
fields.note: A zero byte closing the text, which the length above counts.
